name: DeLaurenti Frozen 3 Cheese Pizza
tagline: Housemade frozen pizza! Makes a great base to customize!
description: That's right, folks - DeLaurenti frozen pizza is finally here! Sure you can buy all the things you need to make great pizza here in the shop, but sometimes you would like someone to do the work for you. This pizza is for those times. The 3 Cheese has a DeLa-Famous pizza sauce base, house shredded mozzarella, Parmigiano-Reggiano & Fontina Val d'Aosta DOP - all thoughtfully piled on an imported Pinsa Crust. Preheat your oven to 500 and cook it right from frozen! Enjoy as is or use this as your base to pile all your favorite toppings to customize!

name: DeLaurenti Frozen Funghi Pizza
tagline: Housemade frozen pizza!
description: That's right, folks - DeLaurenti frozen pizza is finally here! Sure you can buy all the things you need to make great pizza here in the shop, but sometimes you would like someone to do the work for you. This pizza is for those times. The Funghi has an olive oil/garlic base, fresh mozzarella, a touch of lightly smoked mozzarella, Parmigiano-Reggiano, sauteed garlic mushrooms & caramelized onions - all thoughtfully arranged on an imported Pinsa Crust. Preheat your oven to 500 and cook it right from frozen! Finish it with a healthy pinch of chopped Italian parsley and you are good!

name: DeLaurenti Frozen Pepperoni Pizza
tagline: Housemade frozen pizza!
description: That's right, folks - DeLaurenti frozen pizza is finally here! Sure you can buy all the things you need to make great pizza here in the shop, but sometimes you would like someone to do the work for you. This pizza is for those times. The Curly Pepperoni has a DeLa-Famous pizza sauce base, house shredded mozzarella, Parmigiano-Reggiano & our classic curly pepperoni - all thoughtfully piled on an imported Pinsa Crust. Preheat your oven to 500 and cook it right from frozen! Finish it with some more Parmigiano & a pinch of red pepper flakes and you are good!

name: DeLaurenti Frozen Sausage Dust & Suhey Pepper Pizza
tagline: Housemade frozen pizza!
description: That's right, folks - DeLaurenti frozen pizza is finally here! Sure you can buy all the things you need to make great pizza here in the shop, but sometimes you would like someone to do the work for you. This pizza is for those times. Combine the Pennsylvania traditions of Sausage "Dust" with classic, delicious & indigenous Suhey Peppers and you win! Ask for it by name, or just say "I'll have what Nate is having!"

name: DeLaurenti House-made Lasagna
tagline: Made with care in the DeLaurenti kitchen!
description:
Lets face it...the only lasagna that is truly enjoyable to eat is the lasagna you make yourself. It's not complicated, but it takes time. Most of the time, time you do not have. We're here to help. Rather than picking up a box of Stoeffer's at the store by your house, you can now enjoy a lasagna made with care in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. House-made sauce, fresh pasta, the best ricotta, and with the option of meat or veg. The only thing you need to do is set aside an hour to bake it!

serves 2 to 4, 6x6x2.5, apx 3#

name: Macrina Piadina, 6pk
tagline: Made by hand in Seattle!
description: Ok, these things are total game changers. I know you take pride in your pizza dough, but let's face it, you don't always have time to make it. Likewise, fresh baked bread that is still warm is equally hard to come by. Even slicing, oiling and grilling a nice baguette takes effort. Piadina is the cure. Build pizzas and fire them at home...oil up both sides and brown in a skillet until crunchy/chewy and top with a pinch of sea salt...pair with meats cheeses & antipasti...you can even store them in the freezer until you are ready to use them! There is literally no downside. Buy these, you won't regret it.

name: DeLaurenti Pizza Dough, 2 pack
description: You know them. You love them. You find them in our freezer section across from the cafe. Take them home, let them thaw for a few hours, roll them out and you are all set! 2 Pack

name: DeLaurenti Lemon Ricotta Ravioli, 8oz
description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of simple, high quality ricotta, fresh lemon juice and zest, and a touch of pecorino romano. Wrapped with fresh tradtional egg pasta, it is perfect with good quality olive oil and a touch of pasta water.

name: DeLaurenti Mushroom Ravioli, 8oz
description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of porcini, portabella and crimini mushrooms sauteed in sweet cream butter and mixed with spinach, ricotta and fresh herbs. Wrapped in fresh traditional egg pasta, these are perfect with a light cream or butter sauce, or enjoyed simply with good quality olive oil.

name: DeLaurenti Smoked Mozzarella Ravioli, 8oz
description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of smoked mozzarella, asiago and garlic. Wrapped with fresh egg pasta, it's perfect with a light tomato sauce.

name: DeLaurenti Spinach & Cheese Ravioli, 8oz
description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of fresh chopped spinach, fresh ricotta, Parmigiano Reggiano and pecorino romano, with a hint of nutmeg and spices. Wrapped with fresh spinach on one side, and egg pasta on the other, it is perfect with a light red sauce.

name: DeLaurenti Butternut Squash Ravioli, 8oz
description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of fresh oven roasted butternut squash, sauteed onions and a touch of Parmigiano Reggiano. Wrapped with traditional fresh egg pasta, it is perfect with brown butter and sage sauce.

name: DeLaurenti Gluten Free Pizza Crust, 12"
tagline: Just top, bake & enjoy! No more eating salad while your family eats pizza!
description: Everyone else is eating pizza and feeling great. You're not. We get it. Gone are the days when you are relegated to ordering the caeser with some chicken and no croutons. This GF pizza crust is legit! Par baked and ready to be your canvas! Sauce, top & bake in a hot oven or BBQ and you are back in the game!

name: Di Marco Pinsa Crust, 2pk
tagline: Authentic Roman-style pizza crusts!
description: Pizza night just got a lot easier...and better. Pinsa, not to be confused with pizza, is your ticket to recreate amazing Roman-style pizza. It couldn't be easier! Top this par-baked authentic, hand-formed crust with your favorite toppings, bake it off and you are enjoying the flavor of Rome in the comfort of your own home! Seriously...these are just amazing. Cook them right on the rack, on a pizza stone, or even on the grill! Need a make-shift foccacia? Brush with olive oil, herbs & sea salt, bake and you're done! Try them and you won't go back to making your own pizza dough!

name: DeLaurenti Gnocchi, 16oz
description: There are few things better than homemade gnocchi. That said, there are times when you want the enjoyment of eating them, without the requisite effort. These gnocchi are for just such an occasion. They cook quickly and can be combined with a myriad of sauces. Some of our favorites - brown butter & sage, tomato cream, and gorgonzola! Keep them in the freezer and have them at the ready!

name: Fresh Ricotta
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Calabro Cheese Co. - East Haven, CT
description: Calabro ricotta is a special cheese. The texture is impossibly light, fluffy and creamy. Flavors are milky, buttery & sweet. Once you try it, it will be impossible to go back to the generic tubs you find at your local grocery store. The curd is still hand-dipped and hand-packed into Calabro’s instantly recognizable metal containers that are pierced with tiny holes to allow the whey to drain, even after the cheese is shipped. Delicious when enjoyed as is, it is also an essential ingredient for your ravioli, lasagna and cannoli filling. If that's not all, it is also great for baking, or drizzling with honey for an amazing dessert.

name: Manini's Gluten Free Cheese Tortellini
tagline: Finally! Gluten Free Tortellini!
description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. Been on the outside looking in when your family is eating Tortellini? No more. Toss these with a cream sauce, light tomato sauce, or a simple combo of butter, olive oil, a bit of pasta water and some grilled vegetables!

name: Manini's Gluten Free Four Cheese Ravioli
tagline: Finally! Gluten Free Ravioli!
description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. 4 cheeses are better than 1! Toss these with a cream sauce, light tomato sauce, or a simple combo of butter, olive oil, a bit of pasta water and some grilled vegetables!

name: Manini's Gluten Free Portobello Mushroom Ravioli
tagline: Finally! Gluten Free Ravioli!
description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. Filled with creamy cheese and earthen, sauteed portobellos - great with a white sauce, or with butter & olive oil and a splash of pasta water!

name: Manini's Gluten Free Spinach & Cheese Ravioli
tagline: Finally! Gluten Free Ravioli!
description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. Their spinach & cheese ravioli will be your go-to ravioli fix. Creamy, cheesy filling with healthy, great tasting spinach - great with a light tomato sauce!

name: CasCioppo's Hot Sausage
tagline: Seattle's famous handmade spicy Italian sausage
description: A Seattle landmark since 1947, CasCioppo's famous Italian sausage has been our house sausage for over 40 years. Made with garlic, spices, and red pepper, this hot sausage is perfect for grilling, lasagna, meat sauce, pizza, or any other place when you want things to taste better. Cook to temperature with or without the casing and enjoy. Apx 5 to 6 links to a pound.

name: CasCioppo's Mild Sausage
tagline: Seattle's famous handmade sweet Italian sausage
description: A Seattle landmark since 1947, CasCioppo's famous Italian sausage has been our house sausage for over 40 years. Made with garlic and a blend of spices, this sweet sausage is perfect for grilling, lasagna, meat sauce, pizza, or any other place when you want things to taste better. Cook to temperature with or without the casing and enjoy. Apx 5 to 6 links to a pound.

name: DeLaurenti Curly Pepperoni, 8oz
description: As seen on every piece of DeLaurenti classic pepperoni pizza! Use the pepp the pros use! Experience the crispy pepperoni edges and the cup-like shape it takes when baked in the comfort of your own lovely home!

name: DeLaurenti Shredded Mozzarella and Provolone, 1#
tagline: As seen on a DeLaurenti slice!
description: As seen and enjoyed on our famous pizza on 1st & Pike! Walk in the 1st Ave door and smell the unmistakeable aroma of hot pizza coming out of the oven! So what if it's 10:45am...pizza for breakfast! Want to enjoy pizza like this in the comfort of your own home? Well, you can't do it without this cheese. It is mild but flavorful and ultra gooey! Load up and get going! Roughly 1lb of cheese amply covers a large pie.

name: Levoni Speck
tagline: Artisan smoked Italian prosciutto, speck, sliced
description: Speck is a delicately smoked, air-cured ham from South Tyrol, Italy's northernmost province. It is made from the pig's rear thigh, boned and seasoned with salt, pepper, juniper and a touch of sugar. Fantastic when enjoyed with hearty bread, a northern Italian cow's milk cheese, some fruit and a white wine from the Alto Adige. Use Speck the same way you would Prosciutto di Parma when you feel like a touch of smoke - pizza, pasta, antipasti or panini. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Riccio's Hot Calabrian Sausage, 16oz
tagline: Traditional Calabrian-style hot sausage - 4 links per package
description: Riccio's Sausage is made with the highest quality ingredients. They seek to bring you the most authentic and traditional Calabrian flavors by using only the best cuts of prime pork shoulder and absolutely no preservatives. Salsiccia Calabrese, the most popular sausage of Southern Italy, is seasoned with salt, peperoncino picante (Chili pepper), and peperoncino dolce (Sweet Chili pepper). Squeeze them out of the casing and incorporate them into pasta, or throw them directly on the grill and enjoy them with grilled peppers & onions! Hot means hot but not TOO hot. Hot when you can taste the great ingredients, not just the fire.

name: Riccio's Mild Calabrian Sausage, 16oz
tagline: Traditional Calabrian-style mild sausage - 4 links per package
description: Riccio's Sausage is made with the highest quality ingredients. They seek to bring you the most authentic and traditional Calabrian flavors by using only the best cuts of prime pork shoulder and absolutely no preservatives. Salsiccia Calabrese, the most popular sausage of Southern Italy, is seasoned with salt, peperoncino picante (Chili pepper), and peperoncino dolce (Sweet Chili pepper). Squeeze them out of the casing and incorporate them into pasta, or throw them directly on the grill and enjoy them with grilled peppers & onions! Mild in this case does not mean without some spice, it means warmly spiced rather than hot!

name: Belgioso Burrata
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - BelGioioso - Green Bay, WI - 8oz
description: Traditionally from Puglia in southern Italy, this is one of the freshest of all cow's milk cheeses. Milky, sweet, fresh mozzarella on the outside, with molten ribbons of curd and cream on the inside. Each 8oz package contains two 4oz pieces of burrata packed in water for optimum storage. Drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of sea salt and serve with crusty bread. You can work up from there by adding any of the following: grilled bread, prosciutto, salame, sliced tomatoes, fresh herbs, grilled vegetables, aged balsamic or sauteed rapini.

name: Buf Buffalo Burrata
tagline: Pasteurized Buffalo - Buf Creamery - El Rosal, Columbia - 8oz
description: Imported from the Columbia...yes, that's right, Columbia. Trust us, if it wasn't really good, we wouldn't be selling it. You love burrata, we know this. You also love mozzarella di bufula. Well, time for these two to meet. Buf's Burrata di Bufula combines two great things - the bright, tangy of buffalo milk and the molten texture of fresh burrata. Each package contains one, 8oz piece of fresh burrata di bufala packed in water for optimum storage.

name: Buf Mozzarella di Bufala
tagline: Pasteurized Buffalo - Buf - El Rosal, Columbia - 8oz
description: Imported from the Columbia...yes, that's right, Columbia. Trust us, if it wasn't really good, we wouldn't be selling it. Mozzarella di Bufala is wonderfully fresh and delicate with a pleasant tang. This is the perfect cheese to use on your Pizza Margherita, in a salad or with other classic Italian recipes. Each package contains one, 8oz piece of fresh mozzarella packed in water for optimum storage. Voted the #1 Mozzarella in 2016 by the American Cheese Society.

name: Fresh Mozzarella
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Grande Cheese Co. - Brownsville, WI
description: Originally made using water buffalo's milk, the cow's milk version is perfect for your Caprese Salad or Pizza Margherita. Slice into medallions and drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of sea salt for a simple, but satisfying appetizer. Four rounds to a pound, each piece is packed in a little water for freshness. Feel free to add a little tap water for storage. Before using it on pizza, drain the water and let the cheese rest in the fridge for an hour. Pour off excess water (this would have wound up in the middle of your pizza), use and enjoy!
